refuted_claims: lane 1 claim 4: DEFECT (false comment / over-inclusion): The prefix "scripts/dogfood/" is documented as "Repository scripts that run car | judges REFUTED 2 of 3: scripts/dogfood/surface.sh:50 `BIN="$(bash "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/lib/binary.sh")"` and scripts/dogfood/lib/binary.sh:52 `cargo build --release >&2` (runs unless FORJAR_DOGFOOD_BIN is set); docs.sh:62 calls the same lib. surface.sh and docs.sh do run cargo, so the fixture message controls.rs:172 is true for `surface` and the lane's 'stated reason is false' rests on a grep that misses the lib. Refuter 3 is right; refuters 1-2 did not open lib/binary.sh. (comply/harness/quorum/crux-reconcile.sh do have no cargo, so the prefix is somewhat broad, but the claim's evidence is false.) || refuters split (r1,r2 SURVIVED on grep -c cargo of surface.sh = 0; r3 REFUTED). r3 is right: scripts/dogfood/surface.sh:50 `BIN="$(bash "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/lib/binary.sh")"` and lib/binary.sh:52 `cargo build --release >&2` (unconditional unless FORJAR_DOGFOOD_BIN set); docs.sh:62 and contracts.sh:83 call the same lib. So the fixture message for `surface` ("runs a script that runs cargo") and the scan.rs:181 comment are true for it, and the lane's 'docs.sh runs no cargo' is false; the grep missed the sourced lib.

lane 3 claim 3: [DEFECT] The `scripts/dogfood/` prefix is broader than "scripts that run cargo internally" (doc comment at scan.rs:181). | judges REFUTED 2 of 3: scripts/dogfood/surface.sh:50 calls lib/binary.sh, whose line 52 is `cargo build --release >&2`. The claim's exhibit, that the fixture message 'runs a script that runs cargo' (controls.rs:172) is false for surface.sh, is wrong. Refuter 3 is right; refuters 1-2 relied on `grep -c cargo surface.sh`. Some other dogfood scripts (comply, harness, quorum, crux-reconcile) have no cargo, but the named case is false. || refuters split (r1,r2 SURVIVED; r3 REFUTED). The lane's concrete case is false: surface.sh:50 calls lib/binary.sh, whose line 52 is `cargo build --release >&2`, so the fixture assertion at controls.rs:172 is true for surface.sh and a job running it does run cargo. That harness/quorum/crux-reconcile.sh may not run cargo does not rescue the stated defect, whose evidence and example are the surface fixture.
